seoTitle: Add a Product Review Section on Squarespace
metaDescription: Turn on the built-in product review feature in Squarespace so customers can leave feedback on items they've purchased.
intro: Customer reviews build trust and can boost sales, and Squarespace makes it possible to enable a review section directly from your commerce settings. This guide covers finding the toggle and turning on reviews for your products.

steps.heading: Log in to Squarespace
steps.body: Sign in to your account, using Continue with Google if that's linked, then head to your website from the main dashboard.

steps.heading: Open Settings
steps.body: Find the settings option from the dashboard or side menu, depending on your layout.

steps.heading: Go to the Selling section
steps.body: Under Settings, click Selling, which covers all commerce-related features on your site.

steps.heading: Find Product Reviews
steps.body: Within Selling, locate the Product Reviews option, dedicated to enabling and managing reviews for what you sell.

steps.heading: Turn on the review switch
steps.body: Flip the toggle to activate reviews. Once it's on, customers can leave feedback on products they've purchased.

faq.question: Where is the review setting located in Squarespace?
faq.answer: It's under Settings, then Selling, then Product Reviews, where you can toggle the feature on.

faq.question: Can customers only review products they've bought?
faq.answer: Product reviews are tied to purchases, so the feature is designed around feedback from customers who've actually bought the item.

faq.question: Do I need to respond to reviews?
faq.answer: It's not required, but engaging with customer feedback is a good practice for improving your products and building trust.

faq.question: Does enabling reviews require a specific plan?
faq.answer: Product reviews are part of Squarespace's commerce features, so you'll need a plan that includes selling capabilities.
